name: Internal operational event and handoff note

patterns_used: Use a controlled two-page form with explicit lifecycle, approvals, implementation, distribution, optional attachments, and retention metadata.
foundation_lineage.transformation_boundary: Reuse only controlled lifecycle, implementation, distribution, attachment, and retention concepts; create all event facts, roles, wording, and presentation from the new authorized world.

purpose: Record an operational event, actions taken, current state, evidence, risks, open owners, and next-shift handoff.
medium: Native short-form internal note with structured fields and attachment references
lifecycle: Created during the event, updated at handoff, reviewed, and retained

authority.governing_scope: Records observed event facts, actions, and assigned follow-up within the shift.
authority.non_governing_scope: Does not replace source logs, formal incident findings, policy, or external approval.

authorized_inputs: Approved fictional-world event observations and system logs
Actions and handoff knowledge available to the producer
excluded_inputs: Later conclusions presented as contemporaneous knowledge
Invented approvals, signatures, or governing facts
source_boundary.conflict_resolution: Contemporaneous source logs control timestamps and states; unresolved differences remain explicit follow-up items.

natural_depth: Event identity, time, location, equipment, and status
Actions, checks, evidence references, risks, and constraints
Open owners, due times, notifications, and handoff acknowledgement
footprint.source_owned_rationale: The note stays compact because it supports a shift handoff; depth comes only from actual event actions, checks, evidence, and unresolved ownership.

sequence: Open items handed to the next owner
Reviewed note retained with source logs

prohibited: Operational note that supplies an evaluator answer

proof_gates.procedure: Verify event facts, chronology, actions, evidence, risks, owners, and current state.
Render and inspect every page, field, annotation, and attachment reference.
Inspect properties, revisions, comments, timestamps, links, and embedded content.
Confirm the note does not own material executable calculations.
proof_gates.not_applicable_rationale: Source logs and separately validated schedules own quantitative computation.

proof_gates.procedure: Trace observations, timestamps, actions, and attachments to approved world sources.
Scan text, revisions, comments, and metadata for prohibited residue.
Distinguish observations, questions, source logs, and formal findings.
Map every field and note to the operational event and handoff workflow.
